scope: Preserve the distinction between a canonical entity lifecycle and the lifecycle of contextual aliases that resolve to that entity.

sources.meaning: Current canonical project and repository identities.
Typed aliases distinguish project name, abbreviation, repository name, document series, visual branch, and module family.
Current scanner groups lifecycle statuses by normalized_value only.
Prior queue update directs the team to add privacy-safe occurrences and ingest only non-conflicting rows.

claims.claim: The scanner marks both Mirror Cartographer and MC as conflicting because they share one normalized value but carry different lifecycle statuses.
This is a semantic false positive: canonical is the entity lifecycle, while accepted_contextual_alias is the alias lifecycle; the statuses are not mutually exclusive.
Conflict detection should compare lifecycle statuses within a compatible semantic dimension, keyed at minimum by normalized_value plus entity_type or by explicit lifecycle_dimension.
Any differing lifecycle statuses attached to one normalized value constitute a contradiction.
The repository does not yet define a complete compatibility matrix for project, alias, implementation-container, document-series, branch, and module lifecycle dimensions.

contradictions_resolved.contradiction: The occurrence scanner reports a conflict between the canonical project name and its accepted abbreviation.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: The rows describe different semantic roles. Preserve both; do not treat their status difference as evidence of a project rename or lifecycle contradiction.

falsification_route: Produce an explicit decision record stating that MC replaced Mirror Cartographer as the project name, or define both statuses as mutually exclusive in one lifecycle dimension. Either would invalidate the false-positive classification.

privacy_boundary.included: Public repository paths, blob and commit SHAs, project labels, abstract semantic roles, deterministic scanner output, and contradiction logic.
privacy_boundary.excluded: Raw private chats, private-source passages, personal interpretation, health or relationship material, credentials, and identifying narrative context.

next_action: Add lifecycle_dimension to registry aliases, update scanner conflict keys, and add a regression test proving that canonical project names and accepted abbreviations coexist without conflict while incompatible statuses within one dimension still conflict.
